gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-quicksand: Playful spacing and a skyward x-height give Early GameBoy its cheeky stance, while Quicksand brings straight, constant strokes and rounded bulb-like bowls. Big and short is where the heading earns its keep.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-nunito: Widely tracked letters with short ascenders and big bowls make Ethnocentric feel fast, while Nunito rounds everything off with friendly open terminals. Fast energy up top, soft roundness below, and nothing clogged.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-quicksand: Short ascenders over big bowls give Ethnocentric its speed, while Quicksand draws every stroke constant, with no swelling at the stems. Aggressive and approachable meet without either one giving ground.
gen-dafont-existence-fs-nunito: Neon-tube strokes and porthole counters give Existence its industrial look. Nunito, with big round bowls and open terminals, then softens that hard glow into friendly, approachable text just beneath it.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads soft and rounded, its glassy bowls tall and constant. Galaxy packs a dense, loose-set drama into big lines, while the body font simply keeps its strokes constant for steady reading.
gen-dafont-impact-label-fs-quicksand: Each letter of Impact Label stands alone like a bead on a rod, heavy and commanding against Quicksand. Weighty up top, steady and unshaded below, like a shout beside a hum.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-hind: Hind reads quietly, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Jelly Crazies does its wobbly, nearly sealed-shut playfulness best, while Hind is best at open, steady lines whose c never turns inward.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-hind: Hind sets its lowercase nearly level with the capitals, with strokes as steady as a drawn string. Nasalization does friendly best, floating big lowercase forms apart, while Hind quietly does steadiness.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-nunito: Nasalization floats its big lowercase well apart, with sturdy n arches, while Nunito adds round bowls and open terminals. Give the heading room to grow; Nunito is happy at text size.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-quicksand: Friendly Nasalization floats its big lowercase well apart. Quicksand, with tall glass-bulb bowls and constant strokes, can go a touch larger in the text, since its terminals finish well clear of the stem.
